summary: Corporación América Airports S.A. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, furnishing a press release reporting May 2026 passenger traffic. The filing details a 0.2% year-on-year decrease in total passengers, with international traffic up 7.3% and domestic traffic down 8.5% year-on-year. This is a routine operational update pursuant to Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16 for foreign private issuers, containing no terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics related to a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or capital return is announced.
